name: Authorized Exposure Indicators
description: Guides the owner-verified exposure checks and records only status, category, date and remediation. Never stores secrets.
legal_notes: Sensitive. Needs verifiable authorization. No raw credentials, breach dumps or government identifiers are collected or stored.
quota_note: No network requests (works on local data)
example_output: A de-duplicated dataset saved as evidence, with every finding linked to its source response.
capability_gaps: The breach provider integration (Have I Been Pwned) needs the owner's API key and was not verified against the live service.
Steps marked as review are carried out by a person in the Target Profile screens; the automation does not perform them.

config.prompt: Confirm the person verified ownership of each account or domain checked (email confirmation, provider verification or signed document). A self-attestation is not enough for exposure checks.
Open Target profile > Exposure. Run the owner-verified checks. Record yes/no/unknown, category and date only; never paste passwords or leaked data.
